claims: The first crewed moon landing took place on July 20, 1969.
The first crewed moon landing took place during NASA's Apollo 11 mission.
Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed the Lunar Module Eagle at 20:17 UTC.
Neil Armstrong took his first step onto the surface at 02:56:15 UTC on July 21.
Apollo 11 moon landing date was July 20, 1969.
First step on moon was July 20, 1969, 10:56 p.m. EDT.
Apollo 11 astronauts on surface were Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin.
Apollo 11 Command Module Pilot was Michael Collins.
Apollo 11 returned to Earth on July 24, 1969.
The United States successfully landed a total of six missions on the Moon between 1969 and 1972.
